name: 原発性シュウ酸過多症

summary.text: A disorder of glyoxylate metabolism characterized by an excess of oxalate resulting in kidney stones, nephrocalcinosis and ultimately renal failure and systemic oxalosis. There are 3 types of PH, types 1-3, all caused by liver-specific enzyme defects.
summary.evidence: A disorder of glyoxylate metabolism char
